summary: Quality bulletin QB-368 reported a faulty weld affecting lot LOT-0191 (CHIP-IVI, supplier SUP-12) installed at plant P_IN on vehicles built from 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-03. In response, lot LOT-0191 was placed on hold, 25 stop-sale notices were issued for 40 unsold vehicles across 25 dealers, and 76 owners of sold vehicles were contacted.
decision_reason: The system acted on the confirmed incident because IDs and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the pre-flight check on a sandbox copy of the enterprise passed. Furthermore, the auditor agreed with the planned hold, stop-sale, and owner notification actions, which served alongside the pre-flight check as the decision gates since no live baseline read applies to a quality hold.
